replacements.title: fixes https://github.com/micromatch/picomatch/issues/49
replacements.reason: Existing brace parsing loses balanced/literal brace behavior; distinct from development extglob/globstar families.

replacements.title: fix: disable fastpaths mode for parse method
replacements.reason: Public parse must provide full parse state rather than the matching fast-path shortcut; different contract from wildcard matching.

replacements.title: Foreign key suffix (#570)
replacements.reason: Existing CLI foreignKeySuffix option is not honored across nested/relationship paths; source before the fix already advertises the option. New regression exercises the existing flag.

replacements.title: Fix lint
replacements.reason: Despite the lint title, source adds a default opts object and tests remove explicit defaults: a runtime default-router regression, not just formatting.

replacements.title: Fix #510 thanks to @robinvenneman
replacements.reason: Null field values reach string conversion; a focused runtime guard. This family is already development-only.

replacements.title: Fix duplicate query params error (Issue: #352) (#465)
replacements.reason: Duplicate q parameters produce an array and crash string normalization; no diagnostic development q-search task.

replacements.title: Exposing `Link` in the header instead of `Links` (#394)
replacements.reason: Wrong Link header name in CORS exposure; header transport contract is separate from pagination arithmetic.

replacements.title: fix: callNotFound should run not-found preHandler regardless of registration order (#6965)
replacements.reason: Registration order drops not-found preHandler hooks; development has no not-found-routing task. Related holdout 404 tasks remain clustered.
